title: Dinosaurs
examples: How do scientists know about dinosaurs?
What kind of food did T-Rex eat?

explain.say: Dinosaurs were giant reptiles that lived a very long time ago. We do not see them today.
Scientists find clues about them in fossils. Fossils are remains of ancient life.
Some dinosaurs ate only plants, and some ate only meat. This is a big difference.
Scientists think that a big change in the Earth happened. This caused them to disappear.
When you see a big bone in the dirt, it might be a fossil. That bone shows us what an animal looked like long ago. It helps scientists learn about ancient life.
A common mistake is thinking all dinosaurs were the same size. Remember that some were small, while others were truly giant. Size varied greatly among different kinds.

faq.q: Where do we find dinosaur fossils?
faq.a: We often find them in layers of rock deep underground. Scientists dig them up very carefully.
asks: Can you find dinosaur bones outside?

faq.a: No, some dinosaurs were plant eaters called herbivores. They ate things like ferns and leaves.
asks: What did the plant-eating dinosaurs eat?

faq.q: How long ago did the dinosaurs live?
faq.a: They lived during the Mesozoic Era, which was a very long time ago. It was millions of years ago.
A fossil is a preserved trace or imprint of something from the past. It can be bones or footprints.

faq.q: Why did the dinosaurs die out?
faq.a: The best idea is that a big asteroid hit the Earth. This changed the planet's climate suddenly.

facts: Dinosaurs were reptiles that lived millions of years ago.
Fossils are preserved remains of ancient life.
Herbivores eat only plants, while carnivores eat meat.
The extinction event changed Earth's climate.

quiz.say: What did a plant-eating dinosaur eat?
quiz.why: Plant-eating dinosaurs are called herbivores, so they ate only plants.

wrong.0: This is wrong because rocks are not food for any dinosaur.
wrong.1: This is wrong because 'meat only' describes carnivores, not herbivores.
wrong.3: This is wrong because eating other dinosaurs means it was a meat eater.

quiz.say: What do scientists use to learn about dinosaurs?
quiz.why: Fossils are the preserved evidence that lets us know about life long ago.

wrong.1: Sketches are drawings, but fossils are the actual remains found.
wrong.2: Stories can be fun, but fossils are the real scientific proof.
wrong.3: Museum displays are where we see them, but fossils are what we dig up.

quiz.say: If an animal only eats meat, it is called a:
quiz.why: Carnivores are the specific name for animals that eat other animals for food.

wrong.0: Reptile is a type of animal, not a description of its diet.
wrong.2: Herbivore means it eats plants, which is the opposite.
wrong.3: Omnivore means it eats both plants and meat.
